title: Insurance claim SB-CLM-221
summary: Claim SB-CLM-221 is open for hail damage and is waiting for an adjuster inspection. The policyholder reports that the roof is not leaking. Recommended order: stay off the roof, photograph visible damage safely from the ground, save damaged-property and storm photos, then schedule the adjuster inspection. A roofer is not required before the inspection when there is no active leak or immediate safety hazard, though the policyholder may obtain a written estimate without authorizing permanent work. Avoid climbing onto the roof, making permanent repairs before inspection, signing repair contracts, or discarding damaged materials. If a leak or immediate hazard develops, protect people first, use only reasonable temporary mitigation by a qualified professional, photograph conditions before and after, and retain all receipts.
